item.title: Tencent Will Shut Down Its Yuanqi AI Agent Platform on November 9
item.description: Tencent Yuanqi stops creating new agents and API keys on October 29 and goes dark on November 9. Agents published to WeChat accounts will stop replying; data can be exported until January 9, 2027.
